Commentary.Commentary: Boyd Rankin is being interviewed near the sidelines. He says that it is a special feeling to perform well at his home ground. Mentions that it is a par score and adds that if they start well, they have a good chance of chasing this target down.

At one stage, 200 looked possible but some good bowling towards the latter half of the innings brought the home side back into the game. They picked timely wickets and didn't let the Afghan batters get under them. Peter Chase was the pick of the bowlers for them with three wickets and Rankin gave him good support, picking up a brace. An interesting chase is on the way if the home team applies itself. Join us in a short while.

Great end to the innings from Ireland. They fought back and kept their heads on the shoulders to pull things back. An innings of two halves this. The hosts were brilliant at the start during the Powerplay. They picked up two wickets and pegged the visitors back. Zazai along with his skipper, Afghan, took the onus among themselves, counter-attacked and stroked their way to a 116-run stand. Zazai got to his second 50 in two games and was looking good for his maiden ton but fell against the run of play. Nabi and Zadran tried their best towards the end but didn't last long enough.

OUT! Wicket off the final ball and it is an outstanding catch! In the slot around off, Alam throws the kitchen sink at it but ends up slicing it off the outer half of the bat over covers. Balbirnie backtracks, keeps his eyes on the ball and dives to take it brilliantly. AFGHANISTAN FINISH ON 160/8!
Good bowling! Chase spots Alam coming down the track and bowls a length ball well outside off. Aftab goes at it but misses.
Full ball on middle and leg, Najibullah tries to hit it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen steal a run.

SIX! Bang! Shortish ball on leg stump which comes at a waist height for Zadran. He stands his ground and hammer-pulls it over long leg to clear the fence. 10 from the first three balls, can he finish strong?
Wide! Chase attempts the short ball but it is too high as Zadran lets it go.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Zadran hoicks it away towards deep square leg. Simi Singh in the deep hares to his right and keeps it down to two.
Good length ball on off, Alam clears his front leg and drags his heave towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 150 up for Afghanistan.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched to the fielder at covers. Sensational finish from Rankin. His figures read 4-0-14-2.
Aftab Alam is the new man in.

OUT! What a spell from Rankin and he gets another wicket to his name. Some good death bowling from the hosts here. Slow ball outside off, Rashid is early in his shot and hits it uppishly. The ball skies just outside the inner circle near mid off and Thompson takes another catch.
Short ball outside off, Rashid looks to upper cut this but misses.

Not out! Just a mere formality. Ireland never looked convinced. Zadran taps this to the point region and quickly hares to the other end. Paul there collects it and hits at the non-striker's end. The umpire takes it up but Zadran is well in.
A run out appeal at the bowler's end has been taken upstairs. Seems to be fine though.
Rashid Khan strides out to bat. He can hit some lusty blows. Can he make a difference?

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Rankin digs this one short on middle and leg. Nabi looks to hook this one but does not time it well enough. The ball goes towards deep square leg where Stuart Thompson makes no mistake.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Boyd Rankin is back for his final over.
Connects this time but can only hit it wide of the fielder at square leg for one. 10 runs and a wicket from the 18th over.
Short again on middle and leg, Zadran tries hooking it but misses.
FOUR! Another boundary for Zadran. Chase goes short outside off, Zadran cuts it behind square and finds the fence once again.
FOUR! Short ball aimed at the hips of Zadran who pulls it fine towards the fine leg region. The fielder there dives but to no avail.
Milked through the mid on region for one.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! Afghanistan are losing their way towards the end. A soft dismissal and Shafiq has to walk back. Looks to pull this short ball away to the on side but gets a top edge. Chase runs to his right and has the simplest of catches to grab.
Peter Chase is back on for his final spell.
SIX! 10 runs off the last two balls to end the over and Nabi straightaway joins the party. Pre-meditates to this length ball around the leg side and paddles this over fine leg for half a dozen.
FOUR! Shot! Nabi showcasing his class. Stays in the crease and carves this over cover-point for a good looking boundary.
Shafiq drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower ball on the pads of Nabi who works it through square leg for another run.
Shafiq hits this through mid-wicket to get off the mark.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.

OUT! Back-to-back wickets for the Irish. Asghar has thrown his wicket away and both the set batsmen have to walk back to the den. Little serves a slow ball full and outside off. Afghan gets on his knee and looks to slog it to the on side. He cannot generate enough power behind it and finds Dockrell at deep backward square leg. However, the umpire tells Asghar to wait as he sends it upstairs to check for the front foot no ball. The replays show that Little has some part of the foot behind the line and the marching orders are given to the skipper.
Shafiqullah Shafiq comes out to bat.

OUT! Dockrell gets his well-deserved wicket. Bowls a low full toss outside off. Zazai gets behind the ball and looks to loft it over deep mid-wicket. The ball does not travel the distance and finds Singh near the ropes. Unlucky for Zazai as he misses out on a century but a swashbuckling knock nonetheless. The 116-run partnership is finally broken. Sensational finish from Dockrell. Just 2 runs and a wicket of this 16th over. Dockrell ends with figures of 4-0-19-1.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller ball around off, Zazai hits it to the on side to get off strike.
Brilliant. Dockrell using all his experience here. Darts in a yorker outside off, Zazai gets bat to ball only to the bowler. Three dots in a row. Can he end it well?
Dot ball. Another fuller ball around off, Zazai cannot do much with it.
Full and in line of the stumps, Zazai hits it back to the bowler.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball outside off, Zazai makes room but cannot get bat to ball.

SIX! Top edge and it goes all the way! Small ground and Zazai is making the most of it. Little digs one short on middle and leg, Zazai pulls it but gets a top edge which flies over fine leg for a biggie.

Good slow ball. Saw Afghan getting into position early so darts a slow ball outside the leg stump. Afghan looks to paddle this but doesn't make good contact. It goes just past the keeper and to the short fine leg fielder who keeps it to one.
Short and outside off, cut away in front of square for one.
SIX! Huge! That made some sound! Little bowls an ideal length ball around off, Zazai picks it up and hoicks it over mid-wicket for a sweet maximum. That also brings up the 100-run stand between them.
Joshua Little in for another spell.
The skipper has pushed it to the cover region. Another good over from Dockrell, only 2 from it.
Full again outside off, this time Zazai lofts it over covers. Stirling there, dives but cannot get his hands to it. They pick up a single.
Good ball. Excellent yorker. Darts this one full and just outside the off pole. Zazai cannot get bat to ball.
Loopy ball around off, Afghan dances down but does not make proper connection off it. The ball goes to cow corner. They cross.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Afghan hits it back towards the bowler.
George Dockrell to have a bowl again.
Length again outside off, Zazai opens the bat face and hits it to third man to retain the strike.
Zazai plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
Length ball on the pads of Afghan who flicks it away towards square leg for another run.
Stays inside the crease and tucks this away to the on side to rotate strike.
Goes short again, Afghan pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
Wide. Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman. Rankin digs it short but the ball is too high for Afghan, he ducks under it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Boyd Rankin returns.
Hard hit but just for one. Afghan gets low and slogs this one to the deep mid-wicket region to retain strike. Huge over for Afghanistan, 20 from it.
Zazai has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
SIX! Make that three in the over! Stirling is surely not getting another over. Bowls a low juicy full toss outside off, Zazai gets low and slaps it with power over long off for a huge maximum.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
SIX! Another one! 12 off 2 balls already. This one is a loose delivery from Paul. Serves a full toss on leg stump, Zazai tonks it over deep square leg for a biggie.
SIX! Welcome to the bowling crease, Stirling! What a way to get to his half century. Paul bowls this flat on middle, Zazai gets behind the ball and lofts it over his head to get back-to-back 50s.
Paul Stirling is asked to roll his arm.
Another tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Afghan is happy to block it.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Afghan taps it to the off side and thinks of the run but is sent back by his partner.
Zazai works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller this time, Afghan flicks it in the gap through mid-wicket for one more.
Darts this wide and well outside off, Zazai reaches for it and square cuts it for one.
Stays in and turns his bat to the leg side to get off strike.
George Dockrell is back into the attack.

SIX! The moment the ball left the bat, we knew where it was heading! Short ball on off, sits up nicely for Zazai. He lines it up and pulls it with aplomb over deep square leg for a mammoth biggie. The biggest over of the innings, 19 from it. Can they continue to carry on in the same manner?
FOUR! Extraordinary shot! How well did he strike it! Full ball, tailing in, Zazai stays leg side of the ball and whips it with a strong bottom hand over mid-wicket. Beats the fielder in a jiffy.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Very full ball outside off, squeezed away towards deep cover where the fielder runs to his right and cuts it off to two.

Some confusion but no harm done in the end! Length ball around off, Afghan tries to dab it square of the wicket on the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. He doesn't know where the ball is and hence, takes off. His partner also takes off but he is rightly sent back after the skipper realizes that the ball is down the track.

SIX! In the arc, out of the park! Fullish delivery around off, angling away. Afghan lines it up and hoicks it across the line over deep mid-wicket. It is going, going and sails over the fielder near the ropes.

A play and a miss again! Zazai looks like a dynamic batsman but he has to work on his footwork. Fullish ball outside off, he goes at it with hard hands but fails to get bat on ball. Only 3 from this one.
Beaten! No footwork at all. Length ball, seaming away off the deck. Zazai tries to guide it to third man but gets foxed.
Afghan flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single. The 50-run stand is up between the two. Good going from them.
Short ball in line of the stumps, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Tight but safe! Back of a length outside off, Afghan places it towards Stirling at short third man and takes off. Stirling attacks the ball and tries to score a direct hit at the striker's end but misses. The replay though shows that Zazai was comfortably in.
On a driveable length outside off, Afghan goes for a booming drive but misses.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
FOUR! A gift and gleefully accepted! A friendly full toss on leg stump, Zazai picks it up and flicks it over backward square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Lucky for Zazai! Full delivery wide outside off, Hazratullah throws his bat at it but gets a bottom edge that goes right through the legs of the keeper to the fence behind.
Quicker one outside off, dabbed past point for a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy full delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Good running! Afghan taps this one with soft hands towards covers and scurries across to the other end.
The left-arm spinner, George Dockrell to roll his arm over now.

That's the perfect definition of a toe crusher. A yorker, tailing in prodigiously. Zazai is late to react as he clears his front leg to handle it but does enough to get an inside edge onto his boots. A good first over from Little, only 2 from it.
Leg bye! On a good length, Asghar tries to work it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to the leg side. The batsmen steal a run.

Afghan should have got hold of that one! Slower short ball but ill-directed. It is down the leg side as Afghan swipes it straight to the man at 45. A meter either side of him would have resulted into a boundary.
Fuller in length outside off, Zazai doesn't move his feet much as he strokes it through covers for a run.
Overpitched delivery outside off, Hazratullah pushes it back to the bowler who parries it towards the cover fielder.
On a length on middle, Zazai makes room and drives it to extra cover.
Joshua Little to have a burst now.
Afghan strides ahead and places this one square of the wicket on the off side. 28 from the last two overs has made it a decent Powerplay for Afghanistan but Ireland are still in a strong position.

FOUR! The runs are coming thick and fast now! Leans ahead to a similar ball and slog sweeps it again towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder moves to his right, dives but fails to keep the ball in play. Good effort though.
FOUR! 10 in two balls! That was hammered. Fuller in length around off, Afghan crouches and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary.

SIX! Hit with authority! The skipper is starting to show his colours. Tossed up delivery outside off, Asghar comes down the track and tonks it over wide long off for a maximum. Good momentum for the visitors. That gets him to 1000 T20I runs. The third Afghan to do so.
Slow through the air on middle and leg, helped away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Singh continues to bowl on the leg stump. Zazai tries to flick it away but is struck on the pads.
Back of a length outside off, Afghan rides the bounce and taps it towards point. 13 runs from the over, that's more like it for Afghanistan.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! Boom! Afghanistan need to keep on finding the boundaries and who better than the 20-year old. He gets one in the arc outside off and swings through the line. Doesn't get it off the meat of the bat but the power is so much that the ball sails over the wide long off fence.
FOUR! Streaky but effective! Good length ball in line of the stumps, Hazratullah tries to heave it away but gets a top edge that sails over the keeper and goes to the fence on one bounce.
Wide! Chase loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side, the southpaw fails to get bat to ball but his team gets an extra.
A misfield! In the corridor outside off, on a short of a length, cracked away towards short third man who fumbles to parry it towards backward point. Concedes a single.
Shortish ball, takes off after pitching. Afghan hangs back and taps it towards covers.
FOUR! Poor ball and duly punished! Singh errs in line again, bowling it down the leg side. Zazai lifts his bat and swipes it over short fine leg to find the fence. Second boundary of the innings.
Zazai tries to flick an indrifter to the leg side but is hit on the pads.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Once again down the leg side, helped to the man at 45 for a run.
Short ball, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Going down the leg side, Zazai tries to help it away but is hit on the pads.
Outside off, played off the back foot towards the off side. A run and a wicket from this over.
The Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Afghan is the new man in. Needs to play a captain's knock.

OUT! Ireland are making early inroads! Smart bowling from Chase has brought about the downfall of Shenwari. He bangs a short ball and catches Samiullah by surprise. He tries to go for a pull even though he is in an uncomfortable position. Gets a top edge which flies towards deep mid-wicket. Dockrell comes in a few steps and pouches it safely.
Similar delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards the cover region. As the keeper comes up, he ends up slipping due to the dampness on the ground. Hope he is fine.
A bit of a delay after Gary Wilson fell after slipping. The groundsman comes in with some sawdust. It is being sprinkled behind the wicket as well as on the crease.
Afghanistan need to keep on rotating the strike and put away the bad balls. It is important to make good use of the Powerplay.
Short of a length outside off, holding its line. Shenwari guides it towards point.
Short ball that sits up nicely for Hazratullah. He pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery around off, Zazai drives it crisply towards the mid off fielder.
Peter Chase comes into the attack.
Sliding down the leg side, Zazai plays it off the inner half towards short fine leg for a run. A wicket and 2 from the over.
On middle and leg, helped away towards mid-wicket for a run.
Samiullah Shenwari comes out to bat.

OUT! Singh draws first blood! Shahzad was itching to put him to the cleaners but he is the one who is heading back. On a flatter trajectory outside off, skidding after pitching. Shahzad tries to go over mid on perhaps but gets a leading edge that lobs behind. Boyd Rankin at short third man accepts it gleefully. Not the ideal start for Afghanistan.
Similar delivery outside off, straighter one, slapped away towards point again.
A touch ahead, skidding off the deck. Shahzad tries to tonk it down the ground but misses.
Starts off with a shortish ball outside off, cut away towards point where the fielder dives to his right to make a good stop.
Simi Singh to share the new ball from the other end.
A play and a miss again! A short ball outside off, Hazratullah tries to pull it across the line but gets foxed. A decent start for Ireland, only 5 from it.
Almost an edge! Good stuff from Rankin. He hits the deck hard and bowls an away shaping ball around off. Zazai fishes at it and misses.

FOUR! Intent straightaway! He is taking the attack from where he left off in the last game. This time Rankin bowls a fuller length ball outside off, Zazai clears his front leg and hits it hard over extra cover for a boundary.
In the same channel, angling away from the southpaw. He plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Similar length ball on middle and off, tucked with a closed bat face towards short mid-wicket.
Afghanistan and Shahzad are away! Back of a length ball around off, angling in, Mohammad makes a bit of room and taps it away to third man.

We are set to get rolling on an overcast afternoon. The men who matter stride out to the middle. Mohammad Shahzad and Hazratullah Zazai to open the batting for Afghanistan. The visitors will hope for another solid start from them. Boyd Rankin to steam in with the new ball first up. Here we go...

TOSS - Afghanistan win the toss and opt to bat. There is a sole change for both teams. For the visitors, Shafiqullah Shafiq comes in for Usman Ghani. On the other hand, the hosts have brought in Boyd Rankin who is replacing Tyrone Kane.

The Irishmen, on the other hand, need to fire on all cylinders. They have shown sparks of potential here and there but they have to understand the value of clicking as a unit. A do-or-die encounter is enough to make them strive for the best. Let's hope the rain stays away so that we can witness a complete explosive match. The toss is coming up in a while...

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the second T20I between Ireland and Afghanistan at the Bready Cricket Club. The visitors would be aiming to carry their momentum forward. The fact that they have won their last 6 games against the hosts in this format augurs really well for them.
